top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Drucker, Holst and Mojsov for the physiology of GLP-1 and its bioactive form. It rests on a continuous, independently replicated chain from peptide physiology and receptor biology through large outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal disease, so maturity is not in doubt. The three-name allocation is defensible, though the Mojsov/Habener priority and Knudsen's omission remain acknowledged weaknesses. These do not justify withholding the prize.
